PROCESS

HOW I
WORK

A structured yet flexible approach to every project. From first conversation to final delivery.

01
DISCOVER

Understanding your brand, audience, goals, and constraints through research and conversation.

02
DEFINE

Synthesizing insights into a clear creative direction, strategy, and scope of work.

03
DESIGN

Crafting visual solutions with precision and restraint: identities, presentations, campaigns and digital experiences.

04
REFINE

Iterating based on feedback until every detail is polished and the work is production-ready.

05
DELIVER

Handing off final assets, files and guidelines. Ready for print, development or distribution.

06
AUTOMATE

Background automation and oversight running across every project. Includes 38+ scheduled workflows, agents built with the open source Hermes runtime, and approval routing that takes high-impact actions to the Founder.
